name: servo
description: Servo unit: a printed servo holder with one STS3215 inside it. Written as `servo <ID>` in robot_structure.md. The servo and holder are always treated as one unit.
mass_note: Holder mass is solid PLA (100% infill), so it is an upper bound. The connecting rods are not included: they are bolted to the servo wheels and move with the driven part.

holder.volume_note: The mesh has 4 open faces, so the volume is approximate.

frame.x: servo shaft axis. The holder is open on both x sides; the servo's two wheels come out here.
frame.z: along the servo's length. z max (79.4) = socket face, z min (19.4) = open end

servo_cavity.description: Snug pocket between the two side walls, closed by the roof, open at both x sides and at the open end.
servo_cavity.servo_orientation: STS3215 stands with its 45.2 mm length along z, 24.7 mm width along y (0.3 mm clearance), and 35 mm (shaft axis) along x.

roof.description: Solid block at the socket end. 47.1 x 35.0 mm, 10 mm thick over the servo, with sloped shoulders down to the side walls.

rod_sockets.description: Square sockets in the socket face. The two prongs of a connecting rod plug into one pair. One pair at each x end, i.e. one pair per servo side.

socket_lock_holes.description: Cross holes along x through the socket pairs, to pin or screw the rod prongs in place.

open_end_notches.description: Square notches in the bottom edge of each side wall, each with a 2 mm pilot hole above it. Same 5 mm section and 10 mm spacing as the connecting-rod prongs.

other_holes.description: Two holes along x at one end of the roof, near the shoulders. Purpose not known.

connecting_rod.description: Flat printed rod that connects a servo to the next part. The round end bolts to a servo wheel; the two square prongs plug into a socket pair of the next part (a servo holder's socket face, or the foot).
connecting_rod.rods_per_servo_note: Inferred: sockets come in two pairs 38.9 mm apart, one on each side of the servo, matching one rod on the output wheel and one on the idle wheel.
connecting_rod.moves_with: the driven part (it is bolted to the wheel)
connecting_rod.fit: 5.0 mm prongs in 5.3 mm sockets (0.3 mm clearance); 14.5 mm prongs in 15 mm deep sockets.
